messages:
Alice W.: Hey team — auditor just asked for three things for next week's ISO check: 1) a timeline of RBAC changes over the last 12 months with PRs/approvals, 2) audit logs showing role_binding approvals and who merged them, and 3) KMS key usage events correlated to service accounts. Can we confirm owner and where to pull each item?

Jordy: I can own the RBAC timeline. I'll pull from our infra repo and GH approvals. Do we need expanded DB roles too or just k8s and cloud IAM?

Alice W.: Start with k8s cluster rolebindings + cloud IAM (GCP) — docs said scope includes infra and platform. If time, include DB roles.

Maria (sec): For logs: Splunk has the k8s audit events we need (index=infra_audit), and GCP Cloud Audit Logs in org project. Retention note: audit index has 13 months, cloud logs are 2 years. Suggest we snapshot relevant time windows (last 12 months).

Samir K.: I'll take KMS side. Quick plan: export KMS Admin Audit logs for key_ring/* and match entries with principalEmail and serviceAccount. We should also include an exported sample of the KMS key version-change events.

Jordy: Question — auditor wants "who approved role changes". Our GH branch protection shows PR reviewers, but approvals can be in-line comments. Do we include PR metadata + merge commit?

Maria (sec): Yes. Provide PR number, author, list of reviewers with timestamps, and merge commit SHA. That traces approval flow. Also include the corresponding iam.* events in cloud logs when bindings actually changed.

Alice W.: Good. auditor_jk — can you confirm scope: do you need separation-of-duties evidence (approval vs merger) separated per environment (prod/stage/dev)?

auditor_jk: auditor_jk: Yes, please separate prod from non-prod. We need at least a 6-month sampling for prod showing approvals and actual binding changes, and a 12-month timeline for all environments. Also include any exceptions and emergency elevations.

Samir K.: Noted. For correlation, I'll produce a CSV with columns: timestamp, keyName, eventType, principal, serviceAccountEmail, requestMetadata.requestorIp. Will that work?

auditor_jk: That format is fine. Also include evidence that keys are rotated per policy (last rotation timestamps).

Maria (sec): Two implementation notes: 1) Splunk query sample for k8s role changes: ```index=infra_audit kind="RoleBinding" OR kind="ClusterRoleBinding" | table _time, user, verb, objectRef, responseStatus``` 2) GCloud audit sample for IAM changes: ```resource.type="project" protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy" OR "SetIamPolicy" | jsonPayload | timestamp | protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail```

Jordy: I'll collect PR list and map to change events. Estimate: 1.5 days to compile PR timeline + mapping.

Samir K.: KMS exports will take ~4 hours to run and validate. I'll include cross-checks against our key-usage monitoring dashboard.

Alice W.: Great. Can we target a consolidated packet by Friday EOD? If blockers, flag here.

ComplianceBot: Ticket created: INC-2026 (ISO evidence: RBAC/KMS mapping) assigned to: Jordy, Samir K., Maria (sec). Due: 2024-05-03.

Maria (sec): I'll start the Splunk snapshots now and share the saved searches. Putting links in the ticket.

Jordy: FYI I'll exclude automated bot-service bindings (infra-controller SA) from the first pass, then we can annotate.

auditor_jk: One more — please include a short narrative (1-2 paragraphs) explaining our change approval workflow and emergency change path. That helps the reviewer.

Alice W.: Got it. I'll draft the narrative after we have the artifacts. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Samir K.: Uploading initial KMS CSV to the ticket in ~3h.

Maria (sec): Saved Splunk search link: https://splunk.redwood.internal/en-US/app/search/jobs/1234567890 (private).

Jordy: Dropping PR list in ticket now.

Alice W.: Closing loop — if anyone hits retention gaps or missing logs, call it out immediately. We may need to escalate to infra for deep retention pulls.

Samir K.: Will do.
